rule: A: the group at the end of the debut arc, as the reader knows it then

diffs.name: Nico Robin
diffs.reasoning: Baroque Works: introduced as Miss All Sunday and still in it when Whiskey Peak ends; she joins two arcs later. Family none (round 2).

diffs.name: Franky
diffs.reasoning: Franky Family: introduced as its head, joins the Straw Hats after Water 7 (Enies Lobby). Family none, a gang of house wreckers.

diffs.name: Jinbe
diffs.reasoning: Sun Pirates, not Seven Warlords of the Sea (ORCH correction 2026-11-09): still captain of the Sun Pirates when Impel Down ends; a Warlord with his own crew takes the crew (as Doflamingo), without one (Mihawk, Kuma) Seven Warlords of the Sea.

diffs.name: Bartholomew Kuma
diffs.reasoning: Seven Warlords of the Sea when met; the Revolutionary Army is revealed years later.

diffs.name: Nefertari Vivi
diffs.debut_arc: Reverse Mountain / Into the Grand Line
diffs.reasoning: Baroque Works (Miss Wednesday) when the arc ends; the kingdom comes in the next arc.

diffs.name: Sabo
diffs.reasoning: Dadan Family: a child in the flashback, the Revolutionary Army only from Dressrosa. Low confidence.

diffs.name: Rob Lucci
diffs.reasoning: CP9: head of CP9 when Water 7 ends; he also shows as a Galley-La foreman; CP0 comes later.

diffs.name: Vegapunk
diffs.reasoning: MADS: the shadowed Punk Hazard flashback shows the MADS lab; the audit proposed World Government, which the infobox does not list. Low confidence.
